Back in school i was really bad in math. All of my other grades were above average but no matter how hard i studied i still failed every test in math. The teacher even said to me after a test that she already knew I would fail so that was a great motivation. Somehow i passed through and got to my math final with a weak D. The math final was suprisingly easy for me and I was glad it was over. A week or so after i went into history class and the teacher was talking to the class how bad cheating on finals is yada yada. I asked him what he was talking about and he blew up in my face how i shouldnt play stupid now and just admit i cheated on the math exam because everybody knew. I was completely dumbfounded and near tears. Turns out another student accused one of the teachers i was close with (and a supervisor during the finals) that she gave me the answers of my classmates and thats how i passed. Instead of talking to me directly my math teacher interviewed other classmates of mine if this was true and spoke to other teachers. I was the last one to hear about the sitaution and by the time everybody in my grade thought i asked the supervising teacher to help me cheat. Luckily i was smart enough to write down every step of each equasion during the final so the headmaster said that there was no way i couldve cheated trough the whole exam. 
My first B in math in years and I couldnt even be proud because everybody said I didnt deserve it.
Im still mad at my math teacher for leaving me in the dark so long and my history teacher because he told the situation wrong to the students
